title: Claude + Blotato = social media on steroids! #ai #aihacks #aitips #learnai #claude
description:
Manage your entire social media workflow inside Claude — create, schedule, grade, and post without ever leaving the app. 🚀

In this Short, I show you how to set up Claude Co-work with custom connectors and five social media skills so you can automate your content system from start to finish.

Comment **“social”** for the setup guide, Bloatato link, and all five skills.
